request.description:
Fetches the CharteredInfo auth token.

The Tests tab automatically saves the returned token into {{eway_auth_token}} — no manual copy-paste needed.

Single-click generate. The backend automatically:
  1. Loads EWB credentials from ewb_settings table
  2. Gets an access token from CharteredInfo
  3. Builds the full EWB payload from the voucher + item DB records
  4. Calls GENEWAYBILL on CharteredInfo
  5. Stores the EWB number in ewaybill_log

trans_mode: 1=Road, 2=Rail, 3=Air, 4=Ship
vehicle_type: R=Regular, O=ODC

The Tests tab auto-saves the EWB number into {{ewaybill_no}}.

item.name: 7a) View E-Way Bill - by EWB No

request.description:
Returns structured E-Way Bill data (Header, PART-A, PART-B) from the local DB — no CharteredInfo call needed.

Response sections:
  header  → EWB No, dates, generated-by, validity, status, is_expired
  part_a  → Supplier GSTIN/name, place of dispatch, recipient GSTIN/name, place of delivery, document no/date, transaction type, value of goods, HSN code, reason for transport, transporter
  part_b  → Mode, vehicle no, from, entered date/by, distance, portal
  cancel  → Cancelled-at and reason (present only when status = cancelled)

item.name: 7b) View E-Way Bill - by Voucher ID

request.description:
Same as 7a but looks up the latest EWB by voucher ID instead of the EWB number.

Useful when you have the sales voucher ID and want to fetch the associated EWB view without knowing the EWB number.
